question: Bad Wolf Bay's chaos ability tells me to planeswalk as part of its effect. Do I planeswalk right away as the ability resolves?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you planeswalk immediately as the chaos ability resolves.
expected.answer: You planeswalk immediately as the chaos ability resolves.
